applies_why: The judge text resolves a chain-vs-chain collision over Isaiah 7:14, so K-C's chain-against-chain footing requirement governs it.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': one reading requires the judge to actually compare the competing chains by their footings rather than separating the dispute into wording and application; the other reading only forbids a stating-verse test and permits an underdetermined label without that comparison.
why: The judge labels the collision underdetermined by separating the challenger's wording answer from the defender's application answer, rather than weighing the competing chains against each other by footing as K-C requires.
